text: This is Witness. A quiet place to bring a prayer, and to come back and witness the answer.
It opens on the Prayer tab. Not a wall of noise — a short, honest feed of prayers from people you actually know. No ads. No algorithm. No endless scroll.

Every prayer here has two halves. First the ask, recorded in the moment it's still raw. Then, whenever it comes, the answer — recorded later, and linked to the ask forever. That pairing is the whole point of the app.
Those answers gather on the He Answered wall. Only answers live here — never asks. It's a place to go when you're still waiting, and you need to see that waiting ends.
Bringing your own prayer takes about ninety seconds. Speak it on video, leave a voice note, or simply type it out. Then you choose who hears it — only you, your circle, your church, or anyone.
The Gratitude tab is a different rhythm. Lighter, warmer, thirty seconds a day — for the small mercies that are easy to walk right past.
Some seasons are too heavy to carry alone. Walk With opens small, facilitated circles — grief, illness, addiction, waiting — where you're accompanied, not fixed.
And sometimes there are no words. So you can simply sit with someone. Light a candle beside a stranger's storm. No chat, no comments. Presence counts.
The You tab keeps your own walk quietly — your journal, your circle, your giving. Private by default, always.
Underneath it all runs the Faithfulness Ledger. Every prayer you brought, every answer you marked. A record of what you asked, and what came back.
Asking. Thanking. Walking together. Faith, on display. Record one prayer today — then come back and mark the answer.
